explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1217 (ESS66 (5)) with the positive answer of [ABLLPSTT26, Thm 1.6]. For a strictly increasing positive sequence with positive lower logarithmic density, there is a divisibility subchain whose counting rate, limsup (#{chain elements < x})/log log x, is at least limsup (Σ_{a_n<x} 1/(a_n log a_n))/log log x. Both limsups are taken in ℝ≥0∞, which avoids junk at small x. The n = 1 weight convention only shifts the sum by a constant, irrelevant after dividing by log log x.
